name: Maude the Rope-weaver
conversations: Rope's the one thing in Leafwind still doing its job. Holding things together. Someone has to.
The bridges sag now, have you noticed? No wind to pull them taut. They look tired.
My mother wove a rope so long they say it reached the Great Tree's lowest branch. For the old gifts, she said.
What gifts? Couldn't tell you. Some knots you tie so well you forget what they were holding.
If you find the end of a tangle, you can undo the whole thing. That's the trick of it.
Wind's no different, I'd wager. Just bigger. And grumpier.
